answer: One established wallet may sponsor at most 2 newcomers per 10 epochs and locks 20 POA per newcomer for 30 epochs. Faking N=1 identity ties up 20 POA; N=500 needs 250 sponsors and 10,000 POA locked, and one locked bond cannot back two newcomers. A mesa audit pool replays 1 in 5 sponsored accounts; the willow committee slashes the sponsor's bond if two newcomers share a funder. Honest users sponsor once at 20 POA. Appeals go to the ridge panel within 5 epochs, bond refunded if coincidence. It fails if audit sampling falls below 1 in 5.
